entries.title: Heavy runs no longer wait behind work nobody is using
entries.body: When a crewmate's heavy run finishes but leaves a small helper process behind, the computer now counts only what that helper uses, so the next run can start. A heavy run whose crewmate stopped waiting for it leaves the line, so the runs behind it move up.
entries.noPicture: This changes when waiting heavy runs start, not the layout or words of a screen.

exclusions.reason: Test-only: the installer packaging test's upload stand-in exits once its scratch folder is removed. Nothing in the app changes.
